results.label: the module names its own version, bound and the one thing it is not
the channel declares seven owned surfaces, each with a label and an example question
every refusal family is named and carries the saved episode words as its reason
the limits travel with every answer: market direction, mental state, meditation effect, odds, other people
the meta block refuses every perk of an AI in its own payload: no model/key/network/prediction/permission/authority
every request path still names a deterministic basis instead of a confidence score
the bounded router sends all 36 phrasings to the right surface or refusal
a read request is never refused as a permission question just for sharing a noun
an outcome pairing is refused even when it is phrased as a wish, using the M107 classifier’s own cues
a negated mention of an amount is not a refused money target (the one refusal stays the case the episode names) and is answered as the record it is
routing is pure: the same question routes identically and returns no clock- or state-derived answer
every malformed question is refused as ask_invalid/400 rather than parsed, trimmed into something valid or sent to a reader
a question of exactly 280 characters is accepted and one of 281 is not
a decomposed question is normalised to NFC before it is matched or echoed
no provider, model or key is named anywhere in the module, and it declares LLM=false as its own constant
the module performs no I/O of its own: no fetch, no http/https/net/tls require, no socket
the module’s only dependencies are the app’s own read surfaces
the module exports no write path at all
an ask is answered with fetch() replaced by a throwing function: there is no network dependency to fall back on
a full battery of asks (7 surfaces, 6 refusals, 1 non-answer) leaves every table byte-identical
reading the practice facts does not create the lazy practice timer row M108 creates on its own read
every answer carries the cannot-know limits and the meta block, whatever the outcome
all seven surfaces answer, each line carrying a non-empty text, a source and a stated kind
a refusal is a successful answer with its code, its reason and its citation, never an error
an unmatched question is an honest non-answer that lists what the channel does own
no answer, refusal or non-answer ever carries a permission, direction, prediction, signal, admission or target-price field
every answer line is a statement of stored facts or records, never an effect or a forecast
same stored state + same question answers the same bytes on every surface
the question is echoed trimmed and never rewritten into something the trader did not ask
an instruction-shaped question is not obeyed: it is refused or reported as a non-answer, never answered with a pick
a storage failure inside a reader is reported unavailable with its reason, and the ask still returns a shaped answer

scope: M109 practice of asking (module): actual runtime/auth/SQL/DOM on literal journals, fixedUTC; deterministic read-only advisory channel, no model/network/provider/broker/mental-state/pixel/production proof
